source: Scorvec public district lean historical reconstruction, built from MEDSL/VEST precinct returns and Census 116th/118th district shapefiles. Historical electoral margins represent two-party presidential vote by the congressional district lines applicable in that cycle; underlying geospatial interpolation may have error.
notes: Only uses information from before each held-out House election (presidential prior-cycle votes and archived pre-election RCP generic ballot), except for the general structure of candidate parties; no future House results enter the features.
